decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's line reaches a new target group for a small firm with a narrow range and little apparent slack, so there is some risk it falls short of aspirations, but with no evidence of a shortfall and the industry growing, satisficing management has no clear trigger to search for alternatives.

The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini series and shares its formulas, production and customers, so it costs little to carry and likely meets aspirations, which gives management no reason to drop it.
